description: Jersey Mike's Subs (franchisor: A Sub Above, LLC) is a submarine-sandwich quick-service franchise system with 3,227 restaurants open at the end of fiscal 2025, franchised in the United States since February 1987 under predecessor Jersey Mike's Franchise Systems. Franchisees operate made-to-order sub sandwich restaurants under a required Area Development Agreement plus a per-restaurant Franchise Agreement, paying a $20,000 initial franchise fee, 6.5% weekly royalty on gross receipts, and up to 6% combined advertising fund contributions. The 2026 FDD's Item 19 reports average unit volume of $1,367,578 across 2,606 traditional franchised restaurants for the January 1 - December 28, 2025 measurement period.
territoryDescription: Designated Territory (protected vs another physical JERSEY MIKE'S Restaurant while not in default); Company reserves all other channels: non-physical distribution (retail/wholesale/online) anywhere, Non-Traditional Venues inside the territory, other businesses incl. competitive ones under other marks, and acquisitions of competing businesses worldwide
